쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
Selection Strategy Operation팀은 마켓에서의 고객의 수요가 높은 상품을 타겟팅 및 분석하는 팀입니다. 마켓 데이터를 바탕으로 구체적인 Selection 계획을 수립하고, 이를 위한 타겟 Pool을 선정하여 우선 순위를 제공합니다. 쿠팡 Retail Selection의 빠른 확장을 위한 Category별로 기준을 운영합니다. 효율적인 Retail Selection 타겟을 확보하기 위하여 프로세스를 수립하고, 개선합니다.
직무 소개
Selection Strategy Operation은 고객 수요와 시장 데이터를 기반으로 쿠팡 Retail Selection의 성장 전략을 수립하고 실행하는 조직입니다. 본 역할은 데이터 기반의 의사결정을 통해 Selection 확대를 주도하고, Selection Identification운영의 프로세스를 설계하고 개선하며, 다양한 이해관계자와의 협업을 통해 비즈니스 목표 달성을 지원합니다. 타겟팅 고도화, 운영 표준화 및 Playbook 구축을 통해 조직의 실행력을 높이고, 신규 비즈니스 및 카테고리 확장 과정에서 핵심적인 역할을 수행하게 됩니다.

The Business Data Science team uses data and analytics to optimize business performance, drive growth, and foster meaningful partnerships, with the goal of ensuring the sustained and impactful expansion of OpenAI's initiatives to maximize the benefits of AGI for all of humanity. You will work on projects such as identifying opportunities for interventions within a customer lifecycle to drive activation & onboarding, identifying target audiences for new feature launches, and measuring the efficacy of emails, events, and other interventions to drive ongoing engagement with our products.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Alexa+ is transforming how hundreds of millions of customers shop by voice, and delivering on that promise depends as much on how we build as on what we build. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to define and deliver the horizontal initiatives that raise the bar across all of Alexa Shopping — leading with the Amazon Stores Agent, the experience that lets customers complete multi-step store tasks through natural conversation on Alexa+ enabled Echo Family Devices, and extending to the cross-cutting programs, including testing and quality automation, that determine how quickly and reliably we ship. You will own a portfolio of very large, cross-organizational programs, remediate endemic problems that no single team can solve alone, and create the mechanisms that keep these programs succeeding with and without your involvement. You will work at the intersection of agentic AI research and production-quality delivery, often in areas where neither the business nor the architectural strategy has been defined, driving clarity where the problem itself is not yet clear. This is a highly visible role: you operate with complete independence, act as a force multiplier across peer teams inside and outside Alexa Shopping, and represent complex decisions and trade-offs to leaders up to three levels above (Directors and VPs). You will operate as an extension of the organization's leadership, anticipating where the org needs to go and building the programs to get it there.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon Stores Agent
-Own and scale the Amazon Stores Agent on Alexa+ enabled Echo Family Devices — launching agentic store actions that let customers complete multi-step tasks across Registries, Payments, Subscribe & Save, Addresses, Orders, and Returns by gathering what's needed through natural conversation and completing the steps on their behalf.
-Drive the program from its first actions to a customer-complete experience, holding a high task-completion bar and standing up the shared foundations — routing, evaluation, and API integration — so customers finish whole tasks hands-free and new actions ship faster over time.

Horizontal Program Leadership
-Define and own a portfolio of very large programs that cut across Alexa Shopping teams and organizations, beginning with the Amazon Stores Agent, decomposing ambiguous, org-level goals into clear workstreams that teams can execute independently.
-Anticipate future needs and stand up new horizontal initiatives before they become blockers, defining the problem, scope, success criteria, and ownership where none exist.
-Remediate critical, endemic problems that recur across teams, driving alignment among engineering, science, and product leaders on shared priorities, sequencing, and trade-offs.

Mechanisms, Metrics & Standards
-Create, optimize, and drive adoption of the metrics, reviews, and operating mechanisms that make horizontal programs measurable and durable, designed to keep succeeding with and without your involvement.
-Establish standards and best practices — including quality automation and shift-left practices that run alongside every developer, generating and executing the right tests across devices, endpoints, and geographies before a change ships — that teams across the org adopt and emulate.
-Track and communicate program health, delivery milestones, technical risks, and resource constraints to senior leadership; be the person escalations are brought to, and show excellent judgment in driving executive-level escalations.

Cross-Organizational Influence
-Build durable partnerships with peer teams across VP organizations and business lines to land programs that require coordination beyond any single org, acting as a force multiplier rather than a single-threaded doer.
-Identify risks and opportunities in technical strategies, architectures, and engineering organization structures, and influence system owners, investment, and technology direction for agentic AI systems.
-Represent complex decisions, difficult trade-offs, and potential solutions clearly, both verbally and in writing, to leaders up to three levels above, helping them understand the decisions they need to make and the options they have.

Community & Talent

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across Canada. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across Canada, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

- Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across Canadian government institutions — spanning federal departments, agencies, crown corporations, and provincial governments — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

- Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

- Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

- Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

- Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across Canada, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

- Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company.

- Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

- Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

- Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

- You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

- You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

- You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

- You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

- You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

Primary requirements

- 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

- A wide, current network of contacts across Canadian government institutions — spanning federal departments, agencies, crown corporations, and provincial governments, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Coverage across both English- and French-speaking Canada is strongly preferred.

- Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

Also required

- Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

- Public policy experience across Canada.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

- Fluency in English and French.

This role is located in Canada.

This is a high-ambiguity, high-trust role for someone who can bring structure to a fast-growing, cross-functional effort without needing formal authority to do it.

Responsibilities

•

Own the end-to-end strategy and coordination for Anthropic's compute build-out in Canada, from initial site selection through construction and operations. While each component will be run by subject matter experts, this role will act as the overall leader and coordinator of that team.

•

Serve as the primary point of accountability for cross-functional workstreams; leasing, financing, energy, government relations/policy, community engagement, construction, and operations.

•

Provide working leadership to the in-country cross-functional team, driving alignment and unblocking issues.

•

Represent Anthropic with government officials, utilities, energy providers, and other external stakeholders in Canada.

•

Build and maintain relationships within the Canadian government and the energy industry to support site, power, and policy outcomes.

•

Track progress and surface risks across parallel workstreams as the country's compute footprint scales from initial sites to multiple gigawatts.

•

Translate between Anthropic's global compute priorities and the specific regulatory, political, and market conditions in Canada.

Requirements

•

Canadian national with established links into government and the energy industry strongly preferred.

•

Structured thinker with a track record of learning new domains quickly and going deep fast.

•

Excellent communicator, comfortable representing Anthropic to senior government, utility, and industry stakeholders.

•

Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct line authority.

•

Hyper-organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to own multiple concurrent workstreams at once.

•

Comfortable with ambiguity; a problem solver who drives structure into undefined situations.

•

Background in energy, infrastructure, or a related sector.

Nice to have

•

Prior experience with large-scale infrastructure or datacenter development.

•

Existing relationships with Canadian federal or provincial government bodies relevant to energy, land use, or industrial development.

•

Experience managing or overseeing capital-intensive projects.

•

Familiarity with the compute, cloud, or datacenter industry.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
